value.rationale: The source treats connected covers and leaves the disconnected case undetermined. This is a complete sharp all-component-weight/two-term classification, exposing competition between genuine sections and nontrivial covering sheets, plus a genuinely unbounded penalty for two equal coefficients, in stark contrast with the connected case. Finite-slice or mere numerical examples are not the sole contribution.
